newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco BMCI bank capital up to $74.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Morocco BMCI bank capital up to $74.2 mln.

text.p: Morocco's Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie has increased its capital to 742.5 million dirhams ($74.3 million) from 618.75 million dirhams, a bourse official said on Friday.

One of the seven banks listed on the Casablanca stock exchange, BMCI carried out the increase through a rights issue of 1.23 million new shares with a nominal value of 100 dirhams each, the official said.
The bank, which is half-owned by France's Banque Nationale de Paris Intercontinentale, issued the shares at 220 dirhams each, he added.
"The bank is pursuing a medium-term strategy aimed at reinforcing its shareholders' equity," a Casablanca Finance Intermediation broker said.
BMCI showed a net profit of 102.5 million dirhams in 1996, up from 61.2 million dirhams in calendar year 1995.
It was last traded on the bourse at 455 dirhams, the broker said.
